X43 is a 80ft AMSCA flybridge motor yacht available for private charter in Dubai, offering an 80ft yacht with three cabins and a large flybridge.

She welcomes up to 25 guests, has 3 cabins and is run by a professional crew of 3. Departing from Dubai Marina, she is a great choice for birthdays, family days and groups of friends, with routes past Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

Charters are available by the hour, for sunset cruises or for the full day. Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
